Each email should introduce our recruitment partnership program and invite them to review our partnership materials at partner-docs.recruitment-alliance.xyz. 
Use varied but professional wording for each email to avoid duplication. 
Ensure that each email is clear, concise, and contains the link to the partnership materials. 
Confirm once all 10 emails have been sent.
